# Copilot instructions for mixpanel_headless

`CLAUDE.md` at the repository root is the source of truth for architecture,
code standards, docstrings, TDD, and environment variables. Copilot loads it
automatically, so this file does not repeat it. If this file and `CLAUDE.md`
disagree, `CLAUDE.md` is correct.

Other instruction files:

- `REVIEW.md`: what matters in a review of this repository, the evidence a
  finding needs, and what not to comment on.
- `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`: notes for one area of the tree.
  Each file names the folder guide (a `CLAUDE.md` in that folder) to read
  first.
- `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`: the review procedure, including how
  to check a finding before you post it.

## Environment

- The setup steps (`.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml`) install
  Python 3.12, uv, and all extras with `uv sync --all-extras`.
- Run Python tools through uv: `uv run pytest`, `uv run python`,
  `uv run mypy`, `uv run ruff`, `uv run mp`. Bare `python` and `pytest` do
  not see the project packages.
- `uv run mp help <Name>` prints the public API reference (signature,
  docstring, allowed values). It needs no credentials and no network.
- This environment has no Mixpanel credentials.

## Hard limits

- Do not run tests under `tests/live/`. Do not pass `-m live`. Those tests
  call the real Mixpanel API, and some of them write data. The default
  pytest options deselect them.
- Library PRs do not edit `conformance/vectors/` or
  `conformance/contract/`. A maintainer records them again once per
  release. Golden and differential JSON files are generated by scripts;
  see `.github/instructions/conformance.instructions.md`.
- Feature PRs do not change version numbers (`__version__`,
  `mixpanel-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`). CHANGELOG entries go under
  `## Unreleased`.
- Code comments, docstrings, docs, CHANGELOG, and README give the reason in
  plain words. They do not cite internal planning documents by number or
  code.
